source_resources.title: micrograd: A tiny scalar-valued autograd engine
source_resources.author: Andrej Karpathy
source_resources.permission_basis: Lawful external linking to MIT-licensed open source repository.
source_resources.prerequisites: Python object-oriented programming and operator overloading from Day 31.
source_resources.selection_rationale: Minimal, readable implementation of scalar autograd and MLP layers directly matched to our project.

compared_candidates.comparison_rationale: Production scale, but too large and complex for tracing by hand in introductory lessons.
Vectorized autograd; micrograd's pure scalar model is pedagogical for hand backprop.

source_resources.safe_fallback: The local projects/autograd engine is runnable offline and matches micrograd semantics.

source_resources.title: PyTorch Documentation: Autograd Mechanics
source_resources.author: PyTorch Contributors
source_resources.permission_basis: Lawful external reference under Modified BSD license terms.
source_resources.prerequisites: Basic understanding of computational graphs and tensors.
source_resources.selection_rationale: Official reference for computational graph construction, backward pass execution, and in-place mutation pitfalls.

compared_candidates.comparison_rationale: Alternative tape-based execution; PyTorch dynamic graph semantics are standard in modern LLM research.
Functional transformations (grad, vjp); PyTorch object-based graph is closer to the beginner micrograd model.

source_resources.safe_fallback: The training loop mechanics and zero_grad requirements are illustrated with runnable Python code.
